contract: The Prompt Library uses a neo-brutalist visual system: warm paper in light mode, ink-black surfaces in dark mode, thick outlines, hard offset shadows, and yellow, cyan, pink, and violet accents. Desktop uses a category rail and prompt grid; narrow screens use a compact category picker and one-column cards. Target viewports are 1440x900 and 390x844.

accessibility.evidence: Source includes a skip link, labeled search, keyboard-operable category controls, visible focus styles, and reduced-motion rules. Rendered keyboard and contrast review was unavailable because the computer-use browser inventory was empty.

responsive.evidence: Source defines desktop, tablet, and phone layouts at 1399px, 1020px, and 680px. Rendered viewport and long-text fit checks were unavailable because the computer-use browser inventory was empty.

loading.reason: Prompts come from a local TypeScript data file, so the page has no loading request.

empty.evidence: A no-results state and clear-search action are implemented but could not be rendered or exercised.

error.evidence: Clipboard failures show a retry state but could not be exercised in a browser.

partial.reason: The prompt collection is bundled locally and cannot partially load from a service.

success.evidence: Copy success feedback is implemented but could not be exercised in a browser.

permission.reason: The app has no permission flow; clipboard access occurs only when a user selects Copy.
